install_app: install a WebAssembly app module into the WAMR component test environment
query_app: query all installed WebAssembly apps in the WAMR component test environment
send_request: send an HTTP GET or DELETE request to a WAMR component app endpoint
check_response_payload: check that a WAMR component app response payload matches expected JSON data
check_query_apps: check that the list of queried WAMR apps matches an expected list of names
